subject: Mutual Plan: draft timeline & owner ask — close window options
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Clara Simmons <clara@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-30T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Plan: draft timeline & owner ask — close window options

Hi Clara — thanks again for the time earlier today. Quick post-call recap and a first-pass Mutual Action Plan attached for your review. I captured the milestones we discussed, two timeline options, and the dependencies we flagged on the call.

High-level recap
- Use case: multi-tenant inference for clinical search + summarization (pilot: 10k queries/day)
- Success criteria: <10% latency regression vs baseline, integration completed in pilot env, and procurement sign-off for pilot billing

MAP (attached) — what I need from you
1) Confirm the primary stakeholders we should list on the plan (owners for security, procurement, and integration)
2) Pick a preferred timeline option below (A or B) or suggest an alternative close date
3) Confirm a weekly check-in cadence so we can keep dependencies visible

Timeline options (targets are target close dates to finalize PO + pilot launch)
- Option A (aggressive): 8-week path — target close: 2027-06-25 — pros: faster feedback loop; cons: requires procurement & security tasks to finish on tight cadence
- Option B (conservative): 12-week path — target close: 2027-07-30 — pros: buffer for internal security review; cons: delays pilot feedback

Key dependencies we captured
- Procurement: PO + T&Cs finalized
- Security: completed questionnaire + (optional) short live review with your security team
- Demo env: access + sample dataset for integration work

Attachments included: MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (master milestone table), discovery-notes.pdf (call notes) — both in the Drive folder linked below.

Suggested next steps
- Reply with stakeholders + preferred timeline (A or B) by EOD Fri 5/7 so we can lock owners and publish the MAP
- If helpful, I can schedule a 30-min MAP review next Tue/Wed — I have availability Tue 10–11am PT or Wed 1–3pm PT

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3MapDraft
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deals/HB-2027-1143

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

--
Attachment stubs: MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), discovery-notes.pdf (pdf)

From: Clara Simmons <clara@healthbridge.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@healthbridge.com>
Date: 2027-04-30T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Plan: draft timeline & owner ask — close window options

Logan — thanks for the recap and for pulling the MAP together so quickly. I reviewed the draft and the two timeline options. A few notes/questions below.

Stakeholders (please add to the plan)
- Tom Alvarez (CTO) — technical sponsor, tom.alvarez@healthbridge.com
- Priya Singh (Procurement lead) — procurement@healthbridge.com
- Mark Ruiz (InfoSec) — mark.ruiz@healthbridge.com

Timeline preference
- We prefer Option A in principle, but procurement has a sprint that ends mid-June. If we can keep the Option A milestones but slide the target close to 2027-06-30 that would make internal approval more likely. If Redwood needs a firm earlier close, call that out and we can try to accelerate procurement.

Dependencies / blockers
- Procurement will need a short summary of commercial terms and an expected invoice cadence (PO vs monthly invoice) — @Priya will confirm which she prefers once she sees the commercial summary.
- InfoSec needs the questionnaire completed (we can provide the security contact for a live review if needed)

Next steps
- Please (A) add the three stakeholder names above to the MAP, (B) update the target close to 2027-06-30 for Option A, and (C) send a commercial summary doc to Priya simultaneously.
- We are available for a 30-min sync next Tue 5/4 10–11am PT if that works for your team.

Thanks — Clara
Clara Simmons
Head of Platform Partnerships | HealthBridge
clara@healthbridge.com | +1 212-555-0133

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Clara Simmons <clara@healthbridge.com>
Date: 2027-04-30T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Plan: draft timeline & owner ask — close window options

Thanks Clara — adding the stakeholders to the MAP now. Logan / Ben — proposed owner assignments below, please confirm or suggest edits.

Owner assignments (proposed)
- Redwood: Logan Wright — overall engagement lead, MAP publication, weekly cadence with HealthBridge
- Redwood: Monica Patel — integration and pilot onboarding owner (I’ll own the demo env & sample dataset coordination)
- Redwood: Ben Carter — customer success and runbook / rollback plan owner
- HealthBridge: Tom Alvarez — technical sponsor; Priya Singh — procurement decision; Mark Ruiz — InfoSec owner

Updated dependency dates (proposed to align with Clara’s ask)
- Security questionnaire completion: 2027-05-20 (Mark Ruiz / Redwood security team review by 5/25)
- Procurement PO target: 2027-06-10 (Priya to confirm; we’ll provide commercial summary by 2027-05-05)

Cadence
- Suggest weekly 30-min syncs starting Tue 2027-05-06 at 10:00am PT (recurring) — can move if HealthBridge prefers an alternate time.

Action items I’ll take this afternoon
- Update MAP_draft_v1.xlsx with stakeholder roster and new target close of 2027-06-30 for Option A per Clara’s note
- Draft the commercial summary for Priya and circulate to Logan for review by 2027-05-05

Ben / Logan — anything to add? Otherwise I’ll push the updated MAP into the Drive and ping Clara once it’s live.

—
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0114
